title: Easy to Assemble
text: Easy to Assemble. We have an outdoor bar table that needed additional seating. While I realize these are steel and could rust if exposed to weather conditions, we are keeping these in the basement and taking them out to the patio as needed for the time being until we find some nice outdoor stools that we like. These were fairly easy to assemble. It comes with an Allen wrench and was put together within 20 minutes. My husband said he could have used his own tools which may have sped up things a little, but it was easy enough without. The stools ook nice and sleek. They aren't very comfortable for extended periods of sitting, but for short term sitting they are okay. One of the poles had a couple of dents on the lower piece. Depending on how much the chair is extended, the dents aren't noticeable because the upper piece covers it up.  Overall, these are decent and affordable stools.
